name: Cloudburst
description: Sudden 80mm/hr rainfall hits the old city. Instant flooding in Walled City and Sindhi Camp.

alert.title: CLOUDBURST: Sindhi Camp Flash Flood
alert.description: 80mm/hr rainfall has caused flash flooding at Sindhi Camp. All roads submerged. Evacuate immediately.

alert.title: FLOOD: Walled City Drainage Overwhelmed
alert.description: Old city drainage system has failed. Johari Bazaar and Chandpol Gate areas flooded.

alert.title: ROAD BLOCK: MI Road Underpass Closed
alert.description: MI Road underpass completely submerged. All traffic diverted via Tonk Road.

alert.title: EMERGENCY: Heritage Zone Evacuation
alert.description: Walled City declared emergency zone. Heritage structures at risk. Full evacuation ordered.
